glossary.definition: 接入账本的业务方，表 merchants，code 为商户编码，其它表用 merchant_code 关联。
商户下的终端用户，表 users，按 uid 与账户、分录、充值、提现关联。
加密资产代码，各表的 token_code，对应 tokens.code；不同币种金额不可直接相加。
账户当前可用金额 accounts.available，按 uid + token_code 唯一。
提现处理中被冻结的金额 accounts.frozen。
一笔业务生成一张凭证（journals，voucher_no 唯一），对应多条分录（journal_entries）。
journal_entries：某用户某币种在某个 bucket（available 可用 / frozen 冻结）上的一次变动，amount 正数为增加、负数为减少，balance_after 为变动后余额。
opening 期初建账、deposit 充值、withdrawal_freeze 提现冻结、withdrawal_settle 提现结算、transfer 转账、adjustment_credit 调增、adjustment_debit 调减、invoice_payment 收款单支付、invoice_refund 收款单退款。
链上入金记录，表 deposits；status=succeeded 为成功。
链上出金记录，表 withdrawals；status 有 succeeded / processing；fee 为手续费，received_amount 为到账金额。
人工调增/调减，表 balance_adjustments，direction：credit=调增，debit=调减。

metrics.name: 分录笔数
metrics.synonyms: 流水笔数, 记账笔数

metrics.name: 凭证数
metrics.description: 记账凭证数量（一笔业务一张）

metrics.name: 充值金额
metrics.description: 成功充值金额；不同币种不可相加，应按 token_code 分组

metrics.name: 提现金额
metrics.description: 成功提现金额；按 token_code 分组

metrics.name: 新增用户数
metrics.synonyms: 注册用户数, 新用户

notes.accounts.available: 可用余额（按 uid+token_code 唯一）
notes.merchants.code: 商户编码，其它表 merchant_code 关联此列

examples.question: 每天的记账分录笔数
examples.sql: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS 日期, COUNT(*) AS 分录笔数 FROM journal_entries GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY 日期

examples.question: 各业务类型的分录笔数
examples.sql: SELECT biz_type, COUNT(*) AS 笔数 FROM journal_entries GROUP BY biz_type ORDER BY 笔数 DESC

examples.question: 可用和冻结分录各有多少笔
examples.sql: SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS 笔数 FROM journal_entries GROUP BY bucket

examples.question: 每个商户有多少用户
examples.sql: SELECT m.name AS 商户, COUNT(u.id) AS 用户数 FROM merchants m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.merchant_code = m.code GROUP BY m.code, m.name ORDER BY 用户数 DESC

examples.question: 账户数最多的 10 个币种
examples.sql: SELECT token_code, COUNT(*) AS 账户数 FROM accounts GROUP BY token_code ORDER BY 账户数 DESC, token_code LIMIT 10

examples.question: 各币种的可用余额和冻结余额合计
examples.sql: SELECT token_code, SUM(available) AS 可用余额, SUM(frozen) AS 冻结余额 FROM accounts GROUP BY token_code ORDER BY 可用余额 DESC

examples.question: 有冻结余额的账户有多少个
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 账户数 FROM accounts WHERE frozen > 0

examples.question: 各状态的提现笔数和金额
examples.sql: SELECT status, token_code, COUNT(*) AS 笔数, SUM(amount) AS 金额 FROM withdrawals GROUP BY status, token_code ORDER BY 笔数 DESC

examples.question: 成功提现的手续费按币种合计
examples.sql: SELECT token_code, SUM(fee) AS 手续费 FROM withdrawals WHERE status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY token_code

examples.question: 各网络的充值笔数
examples.sql: SELECT network, COUNT(*) AS 充值笔数 FROM deposits WHERE status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY network ORDER BY 充值笔数 DESC

examples.question: 每个商户的充值、提现、转账笔数
examples.sql: SELECT m.name AS 商户, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deposits d WHERE d.merchant_code = m.code) AS 充值, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM withdrawals w WHERE w.merchant_code = m.code) AS 提现, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transfers t WHERE t.merchant_code = m.code) AS 转账 FROM merchants m

examples.question: 每天新增用户数
examples.sql: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS 日期, COUNT(*) AS 新增用户 FROM users GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY 日期

examples.question: 各业务类型的凭证数
examples.sql: SELECT biz_type, COUNT(*) AS 凭证数 FROM journals GROUP BY biz_type ORDER BY 凭证数 DESC

examples.question: 余额调增和调减各多少笔
examples.sql: SELECT direction, COUNT(*) AS 笔数 FROM balance_adjustments GROUP BY direction

examples.question: 支持充值的链类型有哪些，各有多少个币种网络
examples.sql: SELECT chain_type, COUNT(*) AS 网络数 FROM token_networks WHERE deposit_enabled = 1 GROUP BY chain_type ORDER BY 网络数 DESC

examples.question: 处理中的提现有哪些
examples.sql: SELECT withdrawal_no, token_code, network, amount, created_at FROM withdrawals WHERE status = 'processing' ORDER BY created_at DESC

examples.question: 按状态统计收款单的单数、金额和已退款金额
examples.sql: SELECT status, token_code, COUNT(*) AS 单数, SUM(amount) AS 金额, SUM(refunded_amount) AS 已退款 FROM invoices GROUP BY status, token_code

examples.question: 分录最多的 10 个用户
examples.sql: SELECT uid, COUNT(*) AS 分录笔数 FROM journal_entries GROUP BY uid ORDER BY 分录笔数 DESC, uid LIMIT 10
